## Fresh complete-change judgment

I assessed the complete delivered initiative against the accepted proposal, Design r8 and Delivery r5, including M1 transaction, M2 unified authoring and adoption, post-PR RC clarification and M3 marker/example. The bounded direction remains fulfilled: one author reconciles behavior, realization, decisions and verification intent in the owning Designs; System owns composition obligations and references component owners; shared interactions have one owner. Workflow coordinates, Test owns adequacy criteria, Review and Closeout owns assessment policy, and specialized review/Delivery/implementation/Verify retain their responsibilities. FU-012–014 explicitly own remaining consolidation. No repository-wide migration, new gate, semantic readiness engine, record schema or release permission is implied.

The authoring skill has clear scope and triggers, governed-versus-portable authority selection, fail-closed malformed signals, relevant conditional resources, usable model and retained feature/architecture/ADR paths, product-direction escalation, observation boundaries and exact affected owner/example/consumer handoff. Installed methods are complete without internal checkout; missing project authority is distinct from missing package guidance. Independent walkthroughs assess actual method outcomes, not only resource presence. Representative scenarios retain their derivation value without becoming an exhaustive test whitelist.

The complete M1/M2 installer path preserves the contract from candidate selection through publication and recovery. It captures the original exact managed roots/state before asynchronous archive work, rejects retired candidate entrypoints and aliases, protects state-implicated/unmanaged boundaries, checks shared-state drift, and admits replacement only through explicit write-state authorization and a verified coherent candidate. The synchronous helper retains project/ancestor identity, pins verified parent inodes and uses basename-only public mutations, exclusive mkdir and no-clobber links. Original and rollback detachment use private sibling destinations under that same pinned parent. Independent writes, root replacement, late open-descriptor writes and incomplete recovery preserve retained material or report conflict. Installed roots verify before shared state publication. Public dry-run/ordinary/init/idempotency, two-root composition and unchanged neighboring targets retain direct proof. M3 changes candidate bytes, not these guarantees; fresh public recovery proof uses the new candidate.

The adopted source mappings transfer the selected method and composition obligations with stable replacement references and decision context. Mixed sources retain their named unmigrated obligations; historical method/ADR bodies and judgments are not silently converted to current approval. The narrow retired-method validator verifies exact preserved bytes and declared contained replacement owners, not a general legacy exemption. RC current compatibility now agrees with RF-SR-06 and CLI retirement; historical material remains explanatory. No current v1 stored-record reader/writer is introduced.

M3 completes that version-domain explanation by giving Markdown the distinct model-document-v1 marker across all seven current models, validator, guidance, skeleton and measured candidates. Retired/unknown/missing/duplicate declarations fail before table checks; remaining structural grammar and stored/transport versions are unchanged. The complete indexed label-normalization example has three locally governed requirements and all eight dimensions, explicit illustrative scope and meaningful outcomes. Its fenced declaration does not count as live parent authority; parent and extracted record validate independently. Example-only changes still require exact example-plus-owner reassessment. Installing the package does not authorize customer marker edits or adopt project policy.

## Cross-milestone assessment and evidence reliance

The current marker and publication cutover compose safely: consumers refer to Design ownership, the installed authoring method uses the accepted marker, selectors retain owner/example pairing, metadata binds the changed resources, and prior original-record identities remain historical. Changes to Markdown format do not revive retired runtime records or weaken installer state checks. All ten Code Review dimensions pass: contract alignment, protective tests, boundary/timing cases, error/recovery, architectural ownership, compatibility, permission safety, derived currency, scoped contribution and sufficient proof.

I freshly inspected the complete final inventory and relevant assembled source paths, compared the prior final basis and M3 delta, and checked current review/evidence identities. Of97 prior final subjects,85 are byte-unchanged;12 changed and3 newly included model subjects form the15 M3 engineering paths. All15 retired source paths remain absent with explicit base hashes below. This is affirmative scope comparison plus semantic impact assessment, not automatic approval retargeting.

Current implementation proof includes454 Node,89 boundary,355 skill and7 npm-publication tests, selected maintained checks, clean installed candidates in all3 targets, independent refreshed MW-01 and actual new-candidate MW-03. I independently ran python3 scripts/test-boundary-first-validation.py ModelRecordTests:12 passed during the immediately preceding M3 assessment; no subsequent engineering bytes changed. Prior unchanged selector156, adapter158, build7 and defensive helper/public/retirement checks retain their original execution identities and bounded applicability: relevant implementation, commands and method bytes did not change, required current archive executions were repeated, and no contrary observation or freshness requirement defeats reuse. A fresh full158 adapter execution is not claimed.

Independent ZIP comparison confirms the same entry sets with only design/assets/design-skeleton.md and design/references/model-authoring.md changed per adapter. Current measured ZIP SHA/size: Codex c5e5614a247db15530d37e5a2666f99df5fec2d288bd3c5c9cb63d717f33bf1b /277103; Claude5f0eba245c45024e2a83b19b8c744998414f70e3f7cc395fb230cca2e5ae8172 /276420; OpenCode12fdb726852a436e27009f0fbe84ecd115df4740215efb7f7c8ee7260c19cb0e /279259. Metadata/release-index hashes match the rebuilt local candidate. This does not claim published release artifacts or hosted CI on the new head.

Current MW-01 independently covers new-model creation from installed skeletons, old-marker owner-authorized revision versus installation with no authority, current indexed parent/example, and example-changed/owner-unchanged handoff. Unchanged common/legacy/architecture/ADR/shared-contract and product-conflict method proof remains explicitly reused on byte-identical resources, not represented as a fresh target-agent execution. MW-03 was repeated against the new actual candidate for coherent replacement, interruption, partial retry rejection, operator backup restoration and idempotence; its old managed neighbor remains preserved. Synthetic semantics and actual CLI evidence are distinguished.

Original des-review-f1–f5 and m1-review-f1/f2 remain resolved with immutable origins and actual remedies preserved. The13 unchanged historical installer prose failures retain their recorded failed basis and existing narrow scope limit; no blanket waiver or all-prose success is inferred. Earlier Verify objects remain complete historical evidence, not current success. Recording-only handoff/review changes do not alter engineering semantics but are not a blanket exemption for contradictory evidence. No unresolved concern or new material finding is supported in this final assessment.

## Independence and limits

Independent nonauthor /root/independent_design_review. Primary-agent authored production and governing changes under user direction. I authored only review/evidence and disposable fixtures. This is a fresh assessment of the complete final contribution and dependencies; prior milestone/final approval labels do not substitute for it.

I changed no engineering, work, routing, prior review or external PR. Distinct Verify must assess the whole chain and final current-state obligations before any successful explanation or PR update.
